notes: Page numbers are scan page numbers (printed page = scan - 22). Most transcriptions were read from high-resolution crops of the full page; the 'tile' field names the quarter where each line falls. Derby Terrace has no heading of its own in this volume: it is an italic group inside the Derby road listing (p63), recorded twice - as a note line inside Derby Road and in full as its own street. Derby road also contains italic groups for Newcastle terrace (one entry, Harry Hirsch), Clinton terrace (Nos. 119-143) and Barrack lane (5 households, no numbers); these stay inside Derby Road and Barrack Lane / Newcastle Terrace are listed as not found as headings. Pelham Crescent is printed 'Pelham trc (North rd. Park)'. North road's bracket is '(Derby road)', but its side lines (Western terrace, Newcastle drive, North lodge) put it in The Park. Doubtful points: Charles Lighting printed at both 24 and 4 Hope drive; 39 printed twice in Park row; Patrick F. Scanlan's line under Barrack lane may be a continuation; 'Hermitage walk' and 'Huntingdon drive' appear inside Lenton road as italic words before a name and may be side-groups rather than house names. Clifton Terrace, Clinton Terrace (as a heading), Clumber Crescent North, Hermitage Walk, Huntingdon Drive, Hardwick Road and Albury Square have no heading in this volume.
